title: hrdscope: open, reproducible HRD triage from routine H&E slides in ovarian cancer
description: MIT-licensed pipeline and benchmark that derives open HRD labels for TCGA-OV from public allele-specific copy-number data, embeds H&E whole-slide images with open-weight pathology foundation models, trains attention-based multiple-instance models with calibrated triage operating points, and ships a predict command for new slides. Research use only.
